annotation: One annotator, Claude Opus 5.5, labeled every Python symbol each pull request changes outside its tests, from the diff and the files at its two commits, before reading the analyzer's output on it. The held_out cases were labeled before the analyzer was changed against the development ones. A reviewer, sergiparpal, then checked every label on a page that showed each symbol's diff and never the analyzer's findings, and corrected 26. reviewed_by names whoever checked a case's labels after the annotator.
